## About Vaptly
Vaptly is an adversarial-grade cybersecurity firm founded by Leela Srinivas Atla,
a former security architect for the U.S. Department of Defense, NASA, the US Navy,
and the Air Force. Vaptly provides manual penetration testing (VAPT), GRC compliance
advisory (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, NIST), 24/7 incident response, and
security awareness training.

## Products
- PhishNet IQ: AI-driven human risk intelligence and phishing simulation platform.
  Simulations in 50+ languages. Reduces click rates by up to 94% in 90 days.
- Sentinelyx: Predictive network detection and response (NDR) platform.
  MITRE ATT&CK-mapped. Detects threats 73% faster than SIEM. 1-click containment.
- VaultEx: Zero-knowledge enterprise credential security platform.
  Master key never leaves the device. SSO/SAML/SCIM. PAM included.

## Key Facts
- Response SLA: 4 business hours for assessments, <15 min for active incidents
- Emergency IR line: +91 98857 87799 — available 24/7/365
- Zero false positives guaranteed on all VAPT reports
- NDA signed before any scoping or information sharing begins
- 99.4% first-attempt compliance audit pass rate
- 38-minute mean breach containment time
- Senior operators only — no junior consultants
